title: Normalized ordinary and sectionwise module pullbacks
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y, there is a natural isomorphism b from ordinaryPull to inverseImageIntegralModules. For every completed module sheaf M and every pro-etale V over Y, b carries the ordinary adjunction-unit section x to the restriction of x along the counit of the postcomposition/base-change site adjunction. All functors are those of [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models, lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image]. No goodness, boundedness, completeness or nonemptiness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03EL, specializing the adjunction and quotient insertion to expanded clause 4 of def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists.

proof.text: Project both completed direct ring maps to every finite coefficient sheaf. The limit-lift formula for inverseImageCompletedCoefficientMap and naturality of the site sheaf adjunction unit reduce the first map to sectionwiseConstantDirectMap. This is the same finite constant-section map that normalizes ordinaryCompletedRingMap. Direct image preserves the coefficient limit, so its projections are jointly monic.

Construct the module adjunction induced by the site adjunction and the inverse coefficient isomorphism. Its unit is section restriction along the site counit. Transport the right adjoint through equality of the ring maps, and use leftAdjointUniq and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app.

lean.statement:
theorem isomorphismOrdinaryModuleNormalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] :
    ∃ b : ordinaryPull l E g ≅ inverseImageIntegralModules l E g,
    ∀ (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) (V : Y.ProEt) (x : M.val.obj (op V)),
      (b.hom.app M).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
        (((ordinaryAdjunction l E g).unit.app M).val.app (op V) x) =
      M.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapPullbackAdj @WeaklyEtale ⊤ g
        (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale g) trivial).counit.app V).op x
